verdict.rationale: Amazon Bedrock is AWS's first-party managed platform giving access to hundreds of foundation models from leading AI companies, with evaluation tools (aws-docs-25, aws-docs-44). A getting-started tutorial shows a frontier model (Claude 3 Sonnet) being called through Bedrock (aws-docs-31). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Bedrock inference API surface, explicit evidence that open-weight models are offered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
